lines.en: The birds went quiet. Something's off.
I tread lightly on the grass roots.

lines.zh: 草原的土，把我的脚踝咬住。
lines.en: Savanna earth grips my ankles.
Water that way. I thirst slowly.
A clearing ahead. I'll have a look.
The sun pushes my shadow along.
That rustle is me on the grass.

lines.zh: 草原的日头，把我的影子拉长。
lines.en: The savanna sun draws my shadow long.

lines.zh: 草原的地气，踩着很舒服。
lines.en: The savanna's warm ground feels good underfoot.
Withered grass wraps my ankles.
The ground's soft. Easy walking.
I drag my feet across the grass.
Dry grass sticks to my shirt.
Clouds come and go; I'm still standing.
Standing till dark still counts as a day.
The moss thinks I'm soil.
I don't chase the road; it comes to me.
Something ticks in the soil. Bug or wind?
Quiet. My feet are taking root.
I count the moss on my rot.
My shadow's longer than this morning.
After long sun, my hide feels warm.

lines.zh: 草原的日头，晒得皮发紧。
lines.en: The savanna sun tightens my skin.
That sound grates worse than wind.
A hundred years of sun. Long dried out.
Basking. Don't stop to talk.
Grass grows on me. Let it.
Another scrap fell off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我就这么站着，等到天黑。
lines.en: I stand like this until dark.
Grass seed settles on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，我听过太多次了。
lines.en: I have heard your steps too many times.
Hold on. Roll up your sleeve.
Another one with an axe.

lines.zh: 你手上那斧子的味，我熟。
lines.en: That axe smell on your hands is familiar.
So you're the one Savanna Zombie mentioned.
Last I saw a person was early dry season.
On the savanna, your eyes are bright.
That iron in your hand. I know it.
You've got the smell of wet dirt.
How did a rock grow two legs?
Don't cut trees, and I won't touch you.
Are you a seed or a grub?

lines.zh: 草原的草籽粘了我一身。
lines.en: Grass seeds stick all over me.

lines.zh: 这点疼，草原的风会带走。
lines.en: The savanna wind will carry this pain off.
Foul water runs between my fingers.
You knocked off a chunk of rotten flesh.
The skin's off. The meat's still there.
A chunk of my bark got knocked off.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，把我晒得发脆。
lines.en: The savanna sun has baked me brittle.
It's these legs that keep me standing.
Another strip of rotten flesh came off.

lines.zh: 干成这样的我，走一步掉一块。
lines.en: This dry, I shed a piece each step.
The seeds in your bag are rattling.
Give me the sapling. I'll plant it.
White powder. Sprinkle it on me.
One handful of soil. Just one.
The grass on me bends toward you.

lines.zh: 金合欢的影子下，我站着。
lines.en: I stand in acacia shade.
A fruit rotted at my feet. Perfect.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，把我的皮晒干了。
lines.en: The savanna sun dried my skin out.
Move that light onto my face.

lines.zh: 草原的日头，把我晒干了。
lines.en: The savanna sun has dried me out.
You back off first. The grass is flattened.
Not painful. Just no apology.
In the dry grass, you stepped on me.
My flower fell, and you stepped on it.

lines.zh: 热风把我的衣服吹成布条。
lines.en: Hot wind shreds my clothes to strips.
I'm not sore. You should be.
That rot's been hanging on for ten years.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳晒得我发白。
lines.en: The savanna sun bleaches me pale.
These old bones are coming apart.

lines.zh: 腐肉上的草屑，被你撞掉了。
lines.en: The grass bits on my rotten flesh fell off.
In the dry season, we split one sip.
The wind scatters my rotten smell.
Once the seeds drop, I guard this soil.
The dry season's short. One approach only.
Don't hide. The grass already covers you.
Let your roots wrap my rotten flesh.
The wind carries a soil smell. Just right.
This one I pulled from between my ribs.
I rot slowly, and I wait long.

lines.zh: 草籽沾在袖子上，别嫌脏。
lines.en: Grass seed on my sleeve, do not mind the mess.

lines.zh: 干裂的土里，翻出个亮块。
lines.en: A glint turned up in the cracked earth.
Grass roots are wound round my knuckles.
Picked up. Into my torn pocket.

lines.zh: 干草上的东西，我捡起来就吃。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the dry grass, I pick up and eat.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，晒得我发白。
lines.en: The savanna sun bleached me pale.

lines.zh: 稀树草原的土，干得能当砖。
lines.en: This savanna soil is dry enough to build with.
A rotten leaf goes in my coat seam.

lines.zh: 一小块腐肉，够我高兴一天。
lines.en: A small piece of rotten flesh makes my day.
What lies on the ground is mine.
Wait till I crouch. Don't rush me.

lines.zh: 草一动，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: When the grass moves, I know where you are.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，晒得我发干。
lines.en: The savanna sun dries me out.
Stand still. Saves me the search.
I'm slow, but I never stop halfway.
This rotting flesh draws the flies.
This patch only lets things in.
The soil is counting your steps.
Run. I walk slow but never rest.
Today's meal is you.
Grass roots are on your soles.
You go round; I take the straight line.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，晒得我皮发硬。
lines.en: Savanna sun bakes my hide stiff.
I can wait. The sun's still up.
The faster you pant, the slower I go.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的汗了，草原很晒。
lines.en: I smell your sweat; the savanna is hot.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就踩到我的根。
lines.en: One more step and you're on my roots.
I follow the grass you flattened.
One of my strides matches half of yours.
There are only so many acacias.
Don't run — grass roots are faster.

lines.zh: 我的手指被干草割开了。
lines.en: Dry grass has cut my fingers open.

lines.zh: 稀树的刺，比我的指甲长。
lines.en: The acacia thorns are longer than my nails.
This is for that stripped bark.
Lend me that axe, woodcutter.
Stand. Screaming won't help.
I lift slow and land heavy.
That was half my strength.
Down you go, flat with the grass.
This arm of mine is no feather.

lines.zh: 这胳膊练了不知道多久。
lines.en: This arm's been practicing forever.

lines.zh: 金合欢的刺，扎进我的腿。
lines.en: Acacia thorns stuck into my leg.
A blade of grass sprouts on my shoulder.
I rise from the dry grass.

lines.zh: 我闻到斧头的味道，金合欢倒过。
lines.en: I smell an axe; acacias have fallen here.
Roots grew under my feet. Who did that?

lines.zh: 旱季的土是热的，我喜欢。
lines.en: The dry season's soil is hot. I like it.

lines.zh: 干草底下有东西把我拱出来。
lines.en: Something under the dry grass pushed me up.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，草都被我压平。
lines.en: When I stand, the grass flattens under me.
Climbed out of the soil covered in mud.
The soil's warm. The sun's enough.

lines.zh: 草根缠在脚上，一步一扯。
lines.en: Grass roots snare my feet at every step.
The grass is taller here. Where is this?
My rot's so dry it catches fast.
My leg snapped. I can't get up.
Water bloats me. I can't sink.
The blast flung me into the tall grass.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder blade.
The light pierces my flesh cold.
No sun, and I'm going cold.
The bolt hit, and my hide curled.

lines.zh: 草原没有崖，我也掉下来了。
lines.en: No cliffs on the savanna, yet I fell.
